roadmap.title: Jumpscare option
roadmap.description: Start the game, open the options and turn jumpscares on.

roadmap.title: Inspect cabins and stare at the four family members
roadmap.description: Judge cabins correctly while staring at the daughter, son, father and mother in their special cabins.

roadmap.title: Finish the day and clear all 41 cabins
roadmap.description: Judge every cabin correctly and leave through the stairs next to the elevator once the balloons drop.

achievements.summary: Judge 8 cabins correctly in a row, then leave through the stairs after the balloons drop and finish the apartment cutscene.

guide.context: A wrong judgment resets the count of correct cabins in a row.

steps.text: Judge cabins with the red or green button until you have 8 correct in a row.
Once the balloons drop, take the stairs beside the elevator and go through the door.
In your apartment, use the door that looks like a cabin and watch the short cutscene.

achievements.summary: Correctly judge all 41 cabins as haunted or not haunted.

guide.context: There are 26 haunted and 15 non-haunted cabins. A wrong judgment or a death puts that cabin back in the pool to redo. A counter in the elevator and a sticky note on the panel show how many are left.

steps.text: Look over each cabin for any movement or change, and check upstairs too.
Press the red button for a haunted cabin and the green button for a safe one.
Keep inspecting until the elevator counter reaches zero.

achievements.summary: Stare at the daughter hiding under the stairs in a non-haunted cabin.

guide.context: This cabin is not haunted because nothing moves, so the green button is correct.

steps.text: Enter the cabin where the daughter crouches beneath the staircase with a finger over her lips.
Keep looking at her for a few seconds until the dialogue plays.

achievements.summary: Stare at the son upstairs in a non-haunted cabin where he has bread beside him.

steps.text: Enter the cabin where both parents eat at the table and the daughter sits beneath the staircase with bread.
Go upstairs and stare at the son, whose face is uncovered, until the dialogue plays.

achievements.summary: Stare at the father standing outside the window in a non-haunted cabin.

guide.context: A haunted version also has the father at the window, but there the window shatters as you approach. That version does not count.

steps.text: Enter the cabin where the father stands still outside the back right window.
Stare at him until the dialogue plays.

achievements.summary: Stare at the mother outside the cabin after she vanishes from the wall portrait in a haunted cabin.

guide.context: This cabin is haunted, so the red button is correct. You may need to stare for about 30 seconds, from the right spot, before the dialogue starts.

steps.text: Enter the cabin where, after you go up, the mother has left the wall portrait.
Leave the cabin and find her standing outside.
Stare at her until the dialogue plays.

achievements.summary: Turn on the optional jumpscare setting and face the jumpscare.

guide.context: The setting is in the options menu after you start the game, not the main menu.

steps.text: Start the game and open the options.
Turn jumpscares on; the jumpscare plays right away.
